player_prompt.intro:
Murakaza neza kuri Frozen Lake!

Uragiwe na 'P' kuri gridi.
Ibimenyetso bya gridi:
  ' ' = Isahani yamatehe (ni nziza kugendagenda)
  'H' = Shimo (ugwa nayo ukayikosa!)
  'G' = Intego (fikia hano ukoreshe!)
  'P' = Aho uri ubu

Ibikorwa biroroshye: hejuru, hasi, ibumoso, iburyo (cyangwa w, a, s, d)
Andika igikorwa gikurikije: [up], [down], [left], [right] cyangwa [w], [a], [s], [d]

Intego: Genda uturutse kuva ku ntangiriro (hejuru ibumoso) ujegera intege (hasi iburyo) utagwa muri shimo!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Igikorwa kibisi gifite muundo mubisha. Koresha [up], [down], [left], [right] cyangwa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Ikora ritatomoka '{action}'. Koresha hejuru, hasi, ibumoso, iburyo canke w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Wagerageje kugenda {action} ariko uciye ugwa mu ruhome!

outcome.win: Urakoze cane! Washitse ku ntumbero yawe.
outcome.fell_in_hole: Waguye mu mwobo! Umukino urarangiye. Warangije {pct}% y'urugendo ruja ku ntumbero.
outcome.turn_limit: Mwarashitse ku rugero rw'intambwe! Umukino urarangiye. Mwamaze kurangiza {pct}% y'urugendo rugana kw'ihangiro.
